controlled_comparison.method: Same Chrome document at /healthz; sequential initial snapshot fetches, with a concurrent cache-busted original logo transfer only in the middle trial. Each response body was fully read.

interpretation: Large concurrent image transfers compete with snapshot traffic over the shared SSH connection. A fresh tunnel also reproduced slow normal pages. Evidence does not isolate old tunnel state or IPQoS as the root cause; no user SSH process was changed.

encoding.webp: lossless, exact alpha, q100, m6, ICC metadata
encoding.pixel_verification: dwebp then ImageMagick compare -metric AE against each resized PNG: zero differences for both
encoding.lossless_scope: Encoding of the resized image; resizing is not pixel-identical to the original1254px image.

limits: Local component tests and captured-source rendering do not qualify production latency. Repeat normal live browser navigation after the sole deployment owner cuts over.
General native coding execution and the full release remain unqualified.
